title: Value of the refresh_token member in an Adobe token response
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member in an Adobe authorization code flow token response, shown as a pretty-printed JSON body, a compact JSON body behind raw HTTP response headers and the output of a curl request.
rationale: The member is the carrier: Adobe documents a refresh_token member in the response object, present only when offline_access was requested and consented. The value is flagged because of the member it sits in, not because of any prefix, length or alphabet, none of which Adobe states; the request-parameter wording about base64 is not established as the token structure. The extent is the member value only.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the refresh_token member of the token endpoint response is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Adobe documents a refresh_token member in the token response object (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: Response object: refresh_token, generated refresh token, by default expires in 14 days; only present if offline_access was requested and consented.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
